reason: The README describes a bundle focused on automating pre-execution review of tool operations and notifying users about approvals, questions, and completed background tasks.

summaries.zh: 一个为 DSH 提供工具执行自动审核、用户确认以及审批和后台任务完成提示音与系统通知的插件合集。
summaries.en: A DSH plugin bundle that reviews tool operations before execution and provides sounds and system notifications for approvals, questions, and completed background tasks.

capabilities: Automatically reviews tool executions before they run
Blocks or allows operations based on review results
Requests user confirmation for uncertain operations
Plays sounds for approvals, questions, and background-task completion
Sends system notifications when background tasks finish
Persists plugin settings and generates a review policy template
